purpose: One-new-example adaptation of every saved fitted linear text/gate model and historical real-data deletion variant, with offline URL metadata and derived ensemble readouts

design.features: freeze original vectorizers, feature extractors, scaler and base experts for learned gates; no vocabulary fitting
design.persistence: exact rank-one coefficient delta scalar and support feature row with private predictions; equivalent to updating original coefficients; initial coefficient hashes verified

url_metadata_policy.kisa: offline extraction from existing private external_eval evaluation_packet candidate whose primary_model_input_sha256 equals template; lowest audit_index selects canonical source; record candidate count and URL feature ambiguity
url_metadata_policy.normal: join existing message_urls lexical features by original normal candidate message_id
url_metadata_policy.URL_labels: message source labels are not independent URL truth
url_metadata_policy.HGB: frozen expert: no supported online one-message coefficient update; report original detection only, no adaptation success claim

gates: frozen original base probabilities; adapt only learned logistic combiner. Derived fixed/equal ensembles have no trainable combiner, report separately using same-support adapted text experts and frozen URL expert
exclusions: Synthetic fixtures and duplicate export formats (ONNX) are not distinct fitted model experiments
Missing historical weights recorded in coverage; no reconstruction from test scores
JEV API base and KJ/KJU lack local trainable model and new-case API features; no new external transmission
Next-action classifier predicts an action rather than normal/smishing and is not applicable to this binary task
guards: All nine support choices, fixed thresholds and checkpoints; no tuning on outcomes
Support excluded; actual recovery defined using per-model baseline; zero remaining misses is null, not 100%
Normal250 are source-labelled development candidates, not operational FPR
Original data/models/reports immutable; bind all accessed source hashes before run and verify after
Private raw data/row probabilities only in new 0700/0600 output; aggregate public reports
Persisted derivative coefficients used only when native stored coef and independently computed sigmoid predictions agree
All-model coverage includes unavailable or non-adaptable reasons, not fabricated scores
limitations: SGD0.1 for linear models versus AdamW2e-5 for neural models are family-specific fixed recipes; optimizer sensitivity is not architectural superiority
Repeated seeds/folds and same support choices are not independent samples
FAGE gate-only adaptation does not jointly retrain all experts; derived fixed ensembles adapt their text experts separately
Canonical URL metadata selection can introduce ambiguity across same masked text; report exact counts
